sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Procurement of Culinary and Ceremonial Grade Matcha

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with commercial and constitutional law hybrid elements)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Alliance Agreement (Colombia, Mexico, Peru, Chile)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF), Ley 1121 de 2006 (counterterrorism financing), Circular Básica Jurídica of Superintendencia de Sociedades; UBO register established by Ley 2010 de 2019 and regulated by Decreto 1023 de 2021 and DIAN Resolution 164 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Certificate of Incorporation (or Legal Existence) of any Foreign Corporate Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Apostilled Power of Attorney for the Local Incorporation Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Passport (UBO and legal representatives)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or notary in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter on the Beneficial Owner or Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP screening against the National Fiscal General Attorney's PEP registry and the UIAF consolidated list; mandatory OFAC/SDN, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated sanctions, and INTERPOL Red Notices; screenings must be repeated at KYC event, onboarding, and at least annually during the corporate life.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) via the Superintendencia de Sociedades and the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be in Spanish or Spanish-transliterable characters; foreign-language tokens are accepted only if accompanied by a notarized Spanish translation and must be semantically clear for Spanish-speaking authorities.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may submit a written reconsideration to the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days, attaching legal arguments and the original rejection resolution. If rejection is maintained, the applicant may file an administrative appeal (recurso de reposición) with the Chamber and subsequently a final appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Sociedades. A new name reservation must be requested if the original 30-day window expires.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable for low-risk distribution companies subject to receipt of commercial correspondence at a physical address; a co-working or registered-agent physical address is sufficient provided it is open during business hours and receives official mail. Pure virtual-only arrangements are not permitted for the issuance of a commercial registration certificate.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low_Risk_Standard: 15% likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection within the first operating year, rising to 25% if UBO or PEP red flags are flagged by the UIAF or the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and clearance at the Cámara de Comercio
Notarization of the SAS deed (Escritura Pública)
Commercial registry registration and filing (Registro Mercantil)
Pre-incorporation UBO registry filing (RUB) preparation and submission
AML/CFT KYC and PEP/sanctions screening bundle for UBOs and directors
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local incorporation agent / AML compliance provider

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille processing and back-office legalization coordination
Registered office address and commercial substance setup for 12 months
Local legal incorporation and due-diligence professional fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Arts. 5, 10, 17, 18, 20, 28; Código de Comercio, Arts. 110, 112, 113, 137; Decreto 1074 de 2015.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil; Superintendencia de Sociedades for oversight.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (or Escritura Pública when in-kind real-property contributions are made), filed with the Cámara de Comercio.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Law 1258/2008; the capital is fixed by the Articles, fully subscribed, and may be paid immediately or on a deferred schedule. In-kind contributions must be transferred at incorporation. No regulatory escrow account is required for a wholesale trading SAS.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1: The Sole Shareholder of Organic Matcha Trading S.A.S., acting under Law 1258/2008, resolves: (1) Approve the Articles of Incorporation and submit them to the Cámara de Comercio. (2) Confirm the subscription of 500 ordinary registered shares comprising all authorized capital, with payment as provided in the capital schedule. (3) Adopt the registered office at Calle 100 No. 11-31, Bogotá D.C. (4) Appoint [Name] as Legal Representative, [Name] as Secretary, and [Auditor] if required, with powers in the Articles. (5) Authorize the Legal Representative to open bank accounts, register the company, and obtain permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, Registro Mercantil and online pre-validation portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names for electronic pre-validation. Request a Certificado de Homonimia confirming that no identical or confusingly similar registered name exists. Include the S.A.S. suffix and state that the principal activity is wholesale distribution of food products under ISIC 4631.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of each shareholder or attorney
Three proposed corporate name alternatives
Power of attorney if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is denied because of homonimia, immediately select an available alternative name and resubmit; no formal appeal is needed because the registry allows a fresh filing with a modified name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary or qualified corporate attorney; online or in-person authentication of signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the SAS Articles of Incorporation containing corporate name, registered office, corporate purpose, share capital, board structure, legal representation, audit rules, and duration. Have all shareholders execute the document. If an in-kind contribution consists of real property, execute the incorporation by public deed before a notary; otherwise use a private document authenticated by counsel.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Homonimia
Minuta de estatutos (Articles of Incorporation draft)
Shareholder passports or national identity cards
Shareholder RUT for Colombian tax residents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the reviewing authority or notary identifies a formal defect, correct the Articles by executing an aclaratory document or a new version of the minuta; the corrected filing retains its original priority if submitted within the response period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registration with Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the signed Articles together with the completed Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial (RUES) at the Chamber of Commerce window or through the electronic portal. Pay the registration fee. The Chamber issues the Matrícula Mercantil and the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Incorporation
Certificado de Homonimia
Completed RUES form
Proof of payment of registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a requerimiento because of missing or inconsistent information, respond within 15 business days with the corrected data. If the application is rejected, the company may refile the corrected application and pay only the applicable re-examination fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Identification Registration (NIT and RUT) with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales, electronic portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After mercantile registration, access the DIAN online portal to request the RUT and NIT. The Chamber of Commerce transmits incorporation data to DIAN; the legal representative validates the identity and signs electronically. State the principal economic activity as CIIU 4631 and select the applicable income tax, VAT, and withholding regimes.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
Legal representative identity document and RUT, if applicable
Corporate email address
Certificate of mercantile registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN reports a data mismatch with the Chamber, correct the underlying registry record at the Cámara de Comercio and then synchronize with DIAN. If the online RUT process is blocked, request an appointment at the nearest DIAN assistance office for identity validation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Commercial Books with Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Commercial Books Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the initial accounting journal (Libro Diario) and general ledger (Libro Mayor) with the Chamber of Commerce before any post-incorporation accounting entries are made. Use physical ledger paper or authorized electronic book software. Obtain the Chamber stamp or digital certification.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
NIT and RUT
Physical or electronic book templates
Board resolution approving the external accountant, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the books do not meet formatting requirements, purchase a compliant template and resubmit with a corrected format. Failure to register books is curable by prompt resubmission before the books are used for accounting records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Share Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank authorized in Colombia (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA) under AML/KYC rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account in the exact legal name of the SAS, presenting the Certificate of Existence, tax ID, board resolution, and identity of beneficial owners. Deposit the paid-in share capital as agreed and obtain a deposit certificate for the corporate records.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
NIT and RUT
First board resolution appointing signatories
Ultimate beneficial owner declaration or identification materials
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional KYC information, provide a supplementary beneficial owner declaration or execute an aclaratory board resolution. If the capital payment is delayed, the certificate can be cured by a later deposit receipt and an updated capital payment schedule.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Land-Use Certificate and INVIMA Sanitary Notification for Imported Matcha
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Curaduría Urbana / Secretaría Distrital de Planeación; INVIMA – Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the Certificado de Uso de Suelo confirming that the registered office and warehouse location permits wholesale food storage and trade. Then prepare and submit the INVIMA sanitary notification or registration application for the imported organic matcha powder. Provide product labels, organic certification, traceability information, and storage procedures. Retain records for each imported lot.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Uso de Suelo
Commercial lease or title over the warehouse and office
INVIMA application form for food products
Certificate of organic production or import certificate for matcha
Final product labels and technical specifications
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the zoning certificate is denied, apply for an administrative review or select a compliant commercial property. If INVIMA issues an auto de requerimiento, answer within the legal term with revised labels or technical data; a rejected application may be refiled once deficiencies are cured.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA – Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos; Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social for food safety standards
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Notificación Sanitaria or Registro Sanitario de Alimentos for imported and wholesale-traded food products

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) or the applicable regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – wholesale distribution and storage of packaged matcha powder does not require a full Environmental Impact Assessment; only general environmental duties apply for waste, sewage, and storage.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process emissions; comply with municipal wastewater discharge limits under Decreto 3930 de 2010, solid waste separation and recycling obligations under Resolución 1407 de 2018, and safely manage any refrigerated storage without ozone-depleting substances.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos for the office and warehouse; structural load certification for storage racking; Occupational Health and Safety System (SG-SST) and emergency plan per Resolución 0312 de 2019.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) by filing the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) through a legal representative before DIAN, attaching out-of-country incorporation documents, proof of representative authorization, and a local address for notification; a registered tax representative is mandatory for non-resident entities executing taxable activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — SAS is subject to the general corporate income tax (Impuesto de Renta) on worldwide income at the 35% headline rate; no pass-through eligibility; territorial scope applies only to tax credits for foreign-source income; no tax-exempt zone.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election exists. Statutory elections are limited to: (1) opt-in for the Régimen Simple de Tributación for qualifying small enterprises (turnover < 100,000 UVT) and (2) election to treat dividends as fully taxable income as opposed to the default deduction regime; hybrid mismatch rules under Colombian tax law restrict cross-border deduction denial, but no elective mismatch rejections are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) — Colombian Value Added Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No threshold for Colombian-domiciled taxable persons (mandatory from first sale); non-resident providers of digital services to Colombian individuals must register when transactions exceed 40,000 UVT per calendar year (approx. COP 1,700,000,000 in 2024).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All sales invoices must be issued as electronic invoices (Factura Electrónica de Venta) and transmitted in real time to DIAN via API or authorized technology provider before dispatch; XML format with mandatory digital signature, and a valid electronic invoice must be generated for every operation; real-time validation (Validación Previa) and digital stamping are compulsory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods and services physically leaving Colombia qualify for the 0% VAT export rate only when the seller holds an active exporter RUT (Registro Único Tributario) mark, the export customs declaration is approved, the goods are removed from the national customs territory, and the export proceeds are repatriated subject to foreign exchange regulations; offshore services require evidence of receipt and use exclusively abroad.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación — DEX)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (Guía de Transporte)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may claw back all VAT exemption benefits upon failure to uphold export documentation standards or repatriate proceeds within 180 days, applying interest plus a 100% penalty of the unwarranted tax benefit under Articles 647 and 648 E.T.; fraudulent zero-rating claims further trigger criminal liability under Article 402 of the Criminal Code and can expose officers of the SAS to up to 72 months of imprisonment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Junta Directiva del Banco de la República acting via its Regulatory Secretariat and Foreign Exchange Department), with supervisory enforcement by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) over authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries and by the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) for customs-linked import/export declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is freely convertible for current account transactions (imports, exports, services) without prior central bank license, but all trade-related payments must be channeled through the official foreign exchange market (Mercado Cambiario) via authorized intermediaries: goods transactions are subject to channeling regardless of amount, and services only when the annual individual amount exceeds USD 50,000. Capital account transactions (foreign direct investment, external credit, portfolio investment) do not require prior authorization but must be channeled and registered with Banco de la República in the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales (RII) to secure the statutory right to remit dividends, capital, and interest abroad. Profit remittance is unrestricted once the underlying FDI is registered, subject to the 35% corporate income tax, the 10% dividend withholding applicable to dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders (where profits have borne corporate tax), and the obligation to file the corresponding exchange declaration (Formulario No. 4) at the time of remittance. No convertibility restrictions apply to the SAS import payment plan (USD/JPY remittances to Japanese and Chinese matcha suppliers) provided the exchange declarations are lodged with the intermediary bank and the supporting commercial dossier (purchase order, commercial invoice, shipping documents, DIAN import declaration) is maintained for audit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from goods must be channeled through the Mercado Cambiario within six (6) months from the date the foreign currency is credited to the exporter abroad; the exporter may either sell the foreign currency to an authorized intermediary (IMC) or deposit it into a local foreign-currency account (cuenta de compensación) opened at a Colombian bank. Channeling is evidenced through Formulario No. 2 (Declaración de Cambio por Exportaciones de Bienes) filed within five (5) business days after the operation. There is no mandatory percentage conversion ratio to COP; export proceeds may remain in USD/JPY/EUR in the compensation account, but each credit must be individually identifiable and backed by the corresponding export declaration.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with attached foreign-exchange channeling module and foreign-currency compensation account
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) plus import letter-of-credit and trade finance desk
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with digital corporate banking and FX pre-payment validation

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for primary treasury use. Colombian exchange regulation reserves FX intermediation (channeling of import/export payments, filing of exchange declarations, settlement with foreign suppliers) to registered IMC banks; offshore fintech EMI platforms (Wise, Payoneer, Murex, dLocal) do not hold IMC status and cannot file exchange declarations with Banco de la República. EMIs may serve only as auxiliary rails for domestic collection (PSE/PayU) or for low-value incidental payments, while all international trade settlements and FDI injections must be executed through a local IMC account to preserve FX compliance, audit trail, and the export-proceeds channeling obligation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is de facto mandatory for first-time corporate onboarding at Tier-1 Colombian banks. The SAS legal representative, or a holder of a notarized and apostilled power of attorney granted by the company, must attend an in-branch interview in Bogotá or Medellín presenting original identification (passport for non-residents), the company incorporation certificate (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by the Cámara de Comercio within 30 days), RUT (Registro Único Tributario), NIT, and a board resolution approving the opening and designating signatories with transactional limits. Remote digital onboarding is not generally available for newly created SAS clients; some banks accept videoconference validation only for existing individual clients of the bank and subject to enhanced due diligence where non-resident shareholders control the entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore beneficial ownership with recent incorporation, minimal capital, and non-resident shareholders controlling more than 5% through a foreign holding structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized bylaws (estatutos) and incorporation registration; capital-subscription payment evidence (SWIFT MT103 or bank credit note); register of shareholders (libro de registro de accionistas) including full UBO details; UBO declaration reports as required by Colombian Resolution 002/2021 of the UIAF; sworn statement of source of funds; apostilled corporate registry excerpt and good-standing certificate of each foreign shareholder; curriculum vitae and professional reference letters of directors; foreign shareholder tax identification numbers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border supplier payments to high-risk or transit jurisdictions routing Japanese matcha through Hong Kong, Singapore, or Malaysia intermediaries, or transfers to shipping agents in jurisdictions flagged for sanctions risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete transaction file per purchase order: supplier KYC (business license, corporate registry extract, ultimate ownership disclosure), signed commercial contract stating INCOTERMS, proforma/commercial invoice with full goods description, unit price and quantity, bill of lading or airway bill with goods description, packing list, certificate of origin (Japan/China), organic certification (JAS or China Organic label plus certificate of analysis), ICA phytosanitary certificate for food product import into Colombia, DIAN import declaration (Declaración de Importación in the SISEX system), payment instruction matching invoice and beneficiary name, and downstream distribution agreement demonstrating legitimate commercial purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity disbursements not aligned with the declared sales cycle, advance payments made before customs clearance, or third-party payments used to settle import obligations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cash-flow forecast and treasury policy; monthly FX channeling report evidencing all import payments cleared on Formulario No. 2; DIAN customs registry number for each shipment; warehouse inbound/outbound records; sales agreements with local distributors or retailers; internal control memorandum confirming payments are made exclusively to the beneficiary named in the conformed commercial invoice; written explanation of any pre-shipment advance referencing the cash-in-advance clause in the supply contract and the corresponding insurance or bank guarantee covering pre-shipment exposure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Legal representative operating solely under a power of attorney granted abroad, or officers refusing to provide local tax identification and residency documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Poder Especial granted for banking and FX purposes before an overseas notary, certified by apostille, translated into Spanish, and protocolized before a Colombian notary; updated certificate of powers from the Cámara de Comercio; appointment act recorded in the company minutes book; NIT certificate of the company and fiscal identification of the non-resident officer; home-bank reference letter of the attorney-in-fact; original and certified copies of personal identity documents.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholders remit FDI by SWIFT MT103 to the SAS operational account at the selected IMC bank; the remittance beneficiary name must exactly match the company RUT, and the bank records the operation under the Banco de la República concept-code tariff applicable to foreign direct investment and files Formulario No. 4 (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales). No prior authorization is required for the entry of equity, but the bank will request the incorporation documents, the board resolution on the capital call, and the shareholder remittance instruction; the exchange declaration must be submitted within five (5) business days of receipt. Any subsequent capital increase must be registered in the RII before dividend distributions or capital repatriations are executed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Import settlement to matcha suppliers in Japan and China is executed through SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers routed via the IMC bank, with Formulario No. 2 (Declaración de Cambio por Importaciones de Bienes) filed at settlement using the appropriate purpose code from the Banco de la República concept schedule for imports of goods. Alternative clearing rails include commercial letters of credit (MT700 issued by the IMC bank, MT707 for amendments) involving documentary presentation (commercial invoice, bill of lading, phytosanitary/organic certificate, packing list, insurance certificate), or documentary collection (D/P, D/A) against courier-delivered documents. Advance payments for matcha are permissible under a cash-before-shipment clause in the supply contract, provided the payee matches the supplier named in the import declaration and the DIAN customs filing is completed on clearance.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/COP forward contracts (forwards de venta o compra) executed with a local IMC bank, requiring an underlying import/export exposure and maturity aligned with the related trade settlement date; the notional cannot exceed the underlying invoice value.

Plain-vanilla foreign-currency options (call/put on USD/COP, EUR/COP, JPY/COP) bought from or sold to an IMC bank, with the premium payable in COP and the contract linked to a genuine commercial cash-flow to avoid speculative classification.

Non-deliverable USD/COP forwards (NDFs) available principally to non-resident counterparties hedging peso exposure outside Colombia; onshore use by a Colombian importer is admitted only in documented hedge structures executed through an IMC bank and linked to the underlying trade position.

Cross-currency swaps (USD/COP) and interest-rate swaps tied to registered external credit or FDI liabilities are permissible for the SAS where the market risk exposure is backed by a balance-sheet foreign-currency position, and the operation must be reported to the IMC bank and included in the foreign debt or international investment registry where applicable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registration Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 2.5 SMLMV (approx. USD 700); suspension of registration; two consecutive years of non-renewal triggers administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Shareholder Approval and Filing of Annual Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval by March 31; filing with Chamber by April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from Superintendence of Companies up to 100 SMLMV; legal capacity to conduct business may be challenged.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: April 8 – May 24 depending on the last two digits of NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 1% of unpaid tax per month, up to 200% of unpaid tax; accrued interest; criminal tax evasion charges for fraudulent filings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Update (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 4 – June 23 depending on last digit of NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 1% of company assets for non-compliance; 5% for false information; potential restriction on tax proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory Revisor Fiscal for SAS with total consolidated assets exceeding 5,000 SMLMV (COP 6,500,000,000 in 2024) or gross revenues exceeding 5,000 SMLMV, or if the entity issues public securities; otherwise optional unless required by bylaws.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (NIIF for SMEs) based on IFRS; full IFRS for public interest entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: SAS must file annual RUBF update via DIAN between May and June, disclosing all natural persons ultimately owning or controlling 10% or more, and must reflect any share transfers in the Shareholders Register within one month; failure to update constitutes a separate violation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Shareholder Meeting Minutes (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)
Board Meeting Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva, if applicable)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% for tax years 2023 onwards for legal entities under Article 240 E.T.; the temporary 10% surcharge applicable to certain energy/oil/coal and mining sectors does not apply to a wholesale matcha powder distribution trade.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No direct statutory tax holiday for wholesale or distribution of organic matcha powder. General incentives potentially available: deduction for investments in science, technology, and innovation equal to 25% of the investment made, subject to registration and compliance; accelerated depreciation of fixed assets acquired in certain fiscal windows; deduction for employment of disabled workers; and VAT-exempt status for export sales. Export revenues remain subject to corporate income tax at 35%; the only permanent relief is through true deductible costs, expenses, and depreciation.
